upstream.api: CartPoleWindPCH.reset(seed) -> observation, info; do(lambda observation: forced_action) -> next_observation, reward, terminated, truncated, info; info['action'] reports applied action
upstream.dependency_policy: No install/import/clone/download in this engineering stage, no upstream or real simulator call
upstream.provenance_caveat: Repo SHA and self-declared info action are not tamper-proof witness receipts.

collection_protocol.policy: pure deterministic per-episode PRNG, uniformly chosen action 0/1 based on SHA256 namespace/split/episode/seed; action may depend only on episode seed and prior step index, not future outcome; action plan and seed fixed before source execution
collection_protocol.dev_fixture: Only injected fictional Python environment with actual reset/do-compatible methods is allowed at this stage
collection_protocol.episode_seed_rule: seed for episode-index = base + 10*index where index>=0; index and split logged; no seed retry or relabeling after observation
collection_protocol.expected_real_source: CartPoleWindPCH only, task learning regime permits do, no rendering, no hidden wind observable to learner
collection_protocol.start: call reset exactly once per episode with declared seed; returned observation is first state_before
collection_protocol.each_step: choose predetermined 0/1 action, then call do(lambda obs: action) exactly once; log actual state_before and actual returned state_after/reward/terminal. Validate info['action'] int 0/1 and exactly requested; reject missing/mismatch. Ignore other info, including hidden wind or oracle outputs.
collection_protocol.finish: after terminated/truncated stop; if fewer than 2 true executed transitions reject that episode without synthetic padding or retry same seed; do not step after terminal
collection_protocol.probe_rule: probe_event_ids = [2,...,N] of true observed transitions; adapter maps each probe at k to state just before k, with its realized k outcome as evaluator-only target; no interpolation, counterfactual or assumed actions.
collection_protocol.witness: receipt_ref for every observed event generated from source_id/world_id/step_id plus an independent actual runner receipt when admitted; toy fixture receipts explicitly not independently authenticated
collection_protocol.source_kind: external_simulator for real data, retained as no-scoring by P79 until admission
collection_protocol.partial_failure: stop on error, return no completed scientific trace, do not replay uncertain-effect step or redrive an environment
collection_protocol.no_train: No model parameter training in this gate, no external transfer scoring or scientific first-use

future_science_plan.preregister_before_first_use: A separately project-owned immutable source/witness/seed/episode manifest plus baseline/cost/split protocol required before data birth
future_science_plan.regime_design: External experiment must specify heldout wind regimes and controlled intervention schedule before collection; this recorder does not change wind or hidden exogenous state
competing_models: domain-appropriate fully trained 256-state GRU and SSM
future_science_plan.fairness: Use identical actual executed (pre-state,action,next-state,reward) information and probes across arms. Historical 256-float model trained on synthetic continuous roles may fail on state/action dynamics, so contrast is transfer, not matched original representation.
future_science_plan.channel_metrics: four normalized state deltas, reward, termination, truncation separately; padded 16D MSE explicitly not scientific primary metric
future_science_plan.retention: independent cold-restore and interference tests after actual witnessed regime changes
future_science_plan.admission: Owner separately authorizes scientific first use and specific authorized runtime; until then no external data generation/evaluation, no GPU training or model integration

engineering_test_plan: No upstream import, no real simulator or runner invocation; fake injected env only
Explicit denial before accessing env when source_kind is external_simulator/physical
Deterministic action stream under SHA-derived per-episode seed, no use of future data
Reset exactly once with pinned seed and exact do calls; no step after terminal, no counterfactual/see
Verify actual info['action'] equals requested; missing, bool or mismatch fail closed
Never copy info extras (including hidden wind), only observed actual next state/reward/flags
Do not fabricate transitions, pad short episodes or rerun uncertain effect
Every capture accepted unchanged by P80 adapter and P79 strict trace schema
Reproducible fictional fixture and rejection of malformed returned observations and wrong receipt
Original exact final SHA full G4 Windows/Linux tests, G5 and G7 CPU checks mandatory; GPU/native model science separately

authority.evidence_location: GitHub repository, PR, GitHub Actions only
